# TokenDanceChat

TokenDanceChat is TokenDance's real-time chat product and AgentHub interaction proving ground. It validates WebSocket chat, PWA behavior, OIDC login, and IM-style interaction patterns before they graduate into AgentHub.

Canonical site: https://chat.vectorcontrol.tech
Identity provider: https://id.vectorcontrol.tech
Repository: https://github.com/TokenDanceLab/tokendance-chat

## Agent Notes

- TokenDanceChat is a TokenDance ID relying party. Do not add direct GitHub, Google, or Feishu social login to this product.
- Authentication should be described as TokenDance ID OIDC. Durable server-backed auth should use backend exchange or an HttpOnly app session.
- The app is also a validation surface for AgentHub-style chat, group, PWA, and assistant interaction features.
- Public docs live in the repository README and docs folder until a dedicated marketing/docs site exists.
- Public discovery files are https://chat.vectorcontrol.tech/robots.txt, https://chat.vectorcontrol.tech/sitemap.xml, and https://chat.vectorcontrol.tech/llms.txt.
- Keep PWA, offline, auth, error, and assistant surfaces aligned across Chinese and English copy.
- If a feature proves reusable for AgentHub, document it as an AgentHub proving-ground result rather than presenting TokenDanceChat as a separate long-term platform.
